evidence.title: Scrimba Explain - Ask any question, get a video back instantly | Product Hunt

name: Scrimba Explain
summary: Product Hunt launch page for Scrimba Explain, which turns a question, file, link or code into an instant narrated video tutorial.
description: The Product Hunt launch page for Scrimba Explain, launched August 13th, 2026. The tool generates a narrated video tutorial about almost anything you ask: upload files, add links, paste code or write what you are trying to understand, and the video explainer comes back with images, code walkthroughs, animations and diagrams. It uses DOM-based playback technology instead of video-generation models.
